source_text:
7.10
Συντελεσθήτω δὴ πονηρία ἁμαρ τωλῶν, καὶ κατευθυνεῖς δίκαιον. ̓Εὰν συντελεσθῇ
ἡ πονηρία τῶν ἁμαρ
τωλῶν, ὁ δίκαιος κατευθύνει τὴν ὁδὸν αὑ τοῦ, μηκέτι
πολεμούμενος ὑπ' αὐτῶν.
pass_a_gloss: Let-be-completed then wickedness of-sinners, and you-will-direct righteous. If should-be-completed the wickedness of-the sinners, the righteous directs the way of-himself, no-longer being-warred by them.
pass_b_english: “Let the wickedness of sinners be completed, and you will direct the righteous” (Psalm 7:10).
If the wickedness of the sinners is completed, the righteous directs his own way, no longer being warred upon by them.

choices.why: συντελέω = bring to completion/end. The righteous is then no longer warred upon. Not ‘let them be killed’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
